youversion.plan: Free, so there’s no plan to share
youversion.kids: A parent can add a child’s profile to their own account; Bible App for Kids is a separate app for ages 6–8
youversion.notes: A 2020 K-LOVE article said Bible App for Kids sent parents weekly progress updates; could not confirm it is current, so not claimed either way.

hallow.plan: Friends & Family plan: up to 6 people, $119.99/yr
hallow.kids: Kids Profiles inside a parent’s account, behind a Parent PIN (US English)
hallow.notes: Closest competitor. Privacy policy says under-13s need verifiable parental consent. Parents see a kid profile by switching into it; no progress-only view found.

dwell.plan: Family plan: up to 6 accounts, $109.99/yr or $17.99/mo

logos.plan: No — each license is for one person
logos.kids: No accounts under 13; a parent accepts the terms for an older minor

abide.kids: 18 and up, or a parent signing up for a minor

bibleproject.plan: Free, so there’s no plan to share
bibleproject.kids: Not directed at children; no kids accounts listed

bible-memory.plan: Top tier includes unlimited family accounts
bible-memory.kids: Each family member keeps their own progress

notion.plan: No family plan; workspaces can be shared
